يقتتلون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَتِلُونَ (yaqtatilūna) /jaq.ta.ti.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# يُقْتَتَلُونَ (yuqtatalūna) /juq.ta.ta.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
